summary.note: Gold SQL written from the sponsor's own hint field; both queries executed, result sets compared (execution match). No LLM judge. n=10 is the sponsor's example set — small, so treat as a smoke number, not a benchmark.

rows.pred:
SELECT c.name AS client_name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id
WHERE c.region = '서울'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM companyx.sales
WHERE quarter = '2025-Q3'

SELECT AVG(s.amount) AS avg_monthly_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'
SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.status = 'in_progress' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT st.id, st.title, st.description, st.priority, c.name AS client_name, p.name AS product_name, e.name AS assignee_name FROM companyx.support_tickets st JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id JOIN companyx.products p ON st.product_id = p.id JOIN companyx.employees e ON st.assignee_id = e.id WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')

SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM companyx.products p
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT d.name AS department_name, e.name AS employee_name, e.salary AS salary
FROM companyx.departments d
JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id
WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM companyx.employees WHERE is_active = true)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.employees WHERE hire_date >= '2025-01-01' AND is_active = true
SELECT name, salary FROM companyx.employees ORDER BY salary ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.contact_email
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.support_tickets st ON c.id = st.client_id
WHERE st.assignee_id IN (SELECT e.id FROM companyx.employees e WHERE e.name = '강은지')
SELECT COUNT(id) AS client_count, industry FROM companyx.clients WHERE region = '제주' GROUP BY industry
SELECT name FROM companyx.products WHERE release_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY release_date
SELECT AVG(price_monthly) FROM companyx.products WHERE category = 'cloud'

SELECT c.id, c.name AS client_name, p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, ct.amount, ct.start_date
FROM companyx.contracts ct
JOIN companyx.clients c ON ct.client_id = c.id
JOIN companyx.products p ON ct.product_id = p.id
WHERE ct.start_date >= CURRENT_DATE

SELECT p.name, c.amount FROM companyx.contracts c JOIN companyx.products p ON c.product_id = p.id JOIN companyx.clients cl ON c.client_id = cl.id WHERE cl.name = 'Client-T' ORDER BY c.amount DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT e.name, COUNT(c.id) AS contract_count, SUM(c.amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON e.id = c.manager_id
GROUP BY e.id, e.name
ORDER BY contract_count DESC, total_amount DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT p.name FROM companyx.projects p JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.contract_id = c.id ORDER BY p.budget ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_projects, SUM(budget) AS total_budget
FROM companyx.projects
WHERE status = 'completed'

SELECT p.name AS project_name, p.end_date, p.status
FROM companyx.projects p
WHERE p.end_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-12-31' AND p.status != 'completed'

SELECT quarter, SUM(amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales
WHERE quarter LIKE '2025-Q%'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_invoices, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.sales
WHERE region = '광주'

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales
WHERE category = 'data' AND quarter LIKE '2025-Q%'

SELECT s.sale_date, s.amount, c.name AS client_name
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
ORDER BY s.sale_date DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE title LIKE '%컨테이너 OOM 발생%' AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
SELECT T1.title, T1.priority, T2.name FROM companyx.support_tickets AS T1 JOIN companyx.clients AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.id WHERE T1.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')

SELECT st.id, st.title, st.created_at, st.resolved_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) AS duration_seconds FROM companyx.support_tickets st WHERE st.status = 'closed' ORDER BY duration_seconds ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
